entities.summary: Julian Charles Porteous is a retired Australian prelate of the Catholic Church. He was previously the Catholic Archbishop of Hobart, Tasmania until his resignation on 20 June 2025. He was previously Auxiliary Bishop of Sydney, Australia, Episcopal Vicar for Renewal and Evangelisation, and Titular Bishop of Urusi (2003–2013).
